notes: Proposed for v2 profiles pending D07 content review. Removes busy/distracted cues ('bit swamped', 'deep in my own crates'), unsolicited 'stuck on <crate>' solicitations and memory claims ('adding that to my notes') from fallbacks.demo v1.
v2 (UX round 3, AI-1/AI-2): warmer pleasantry replies with a question back and more multiword variety per rule for the session no-repeat draw. Still free of busy/stuck/time wording (INV-0705).

v3 (O-1/O-3): asks_intel_nl invites a typed crate ask where no picker exists; identity_probe is the fixed truthful disclosure for 'are you a bot/real?' probes (answered before generation, never model text).

v4 (UX round 4, item 13): the social pool mixes one pleasantry-with-return-question with topically distinct task-state lines, so two seats replying to the same pleasantry cannot converge on two paraphrases of 'doing alright'. Still free of busy/stuck/time wording (INV-0705).
Approved for live pilot fielding (2026-10-06): decisions ['D07'] resolved per PI direction (main-campus IRB confirmed blanket coverage, no amendment); body identical to v4 (proposed_unapproved).
